paragraphs.source_en: Since the matter concerned overseas trade, Ieyasu would certainly summon Chōan for questioning. When that happened, Chōan could ask once more to remain in Sunpu and investigate the matter thoroughly. How could he fail to uncover some weakness in Honda Masazumi? Chōan looked up at the wisteria blossoms and could not help laughing. He murmured to himself, “I am no villain!”

units.source_en: Since the matter concerned overseas trade, Ieyasu would certainly summon Chōan for questioning.
units.source_zh: 事关海外交易，家康定会寻长安问话。

units.source_en: When that happened, Chōan could ask once more to remain in Sunpu and investigate the matter thoroughly. How could he fail to uncover some weakness in Honda Masazumi?

units.source_zh: 斯时长安再请求留在骏府，好生调查，还怕找不到本多正纯破绽？

units.source_en: Chōan looked up at the wisteria blossoms and could not help laughing. He murmured to himself, “I am no villain!”
units.source_zh: 长安抬头看着紫藤花，忍不住笑了起来，自言自语道：“我非恶人哪！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 事关海外交易，家康定会寻长安问话。斯时长安再请求留在骏府，好生调查，还怕找不到本多正纯破绽？长安抬头看着紫藤花，忍不住笑了起来，自言自语道：“我非恶人哪！”

paragraphs.source_en: Had Chōan known that the entire six thousand ryō in silver had not gone into Okamoto Daihachi's pocket, and that Honda Masazumi had also received a share, he would not have been so ruthless as to insist on bringing Masazumi down.

units.source_en: Had Chōan known that the entire six thousand ryō in silver had not gone into Okamoto Daihachi's pocket, and that Honda Masazumi had also received a share, he would not have been so ruthless as to insist on bringing Masazumi down.

units.source_zh: 假如长安知那六千两白银并未全落入冈本大八囊中，本多正纯也有份，他也不会冷酷到一定要扳倒正纯。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan would advise Masazumi to lay every charge at the feet of Okamoto Daihachi alone. After all, Okamoto Daihachi was the same sort of petty scoundrel as Matsuo Matsujūrō. Petty scoundrels naturally had to be handled by their own methods.

units.source_zh: 不管怎么说，冈本大八都是和松尾松十郎一般的小人。

units.source_en: Petty scoundrels naturally had to be handled by their own methods.
units.source_zh: 对付小人，自当用小人之法。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安会劝正纯把所有罪名都安到冈本大八一人头上。不管怎么说，冈本大八都是和松尾松十郎一般的小人。对付小人，自当用小人之法。

paragraphs.source_en: These scoundrels had committed every kind of evil during the age of turmoil. In wartime they had survived by plundering commoners' homes or stripping armor from the war dead and selling it. Now that they had lost the battlefields on which their livelihood depended, they lived by cheating and swindling wherever they went. Such beasts had to be dealt with by the methods used to tame animals.

units.source_en: These scoundrels had committed every kind of evil during the age of turmoil.
units.source_zh: 这帮小人在乱世之中亦是恶事做尽。

units.source_en: In wartime they had survived by plundering commoners' homes or stripping armor from the war dead and selling it.

units.source_en: Now that they had lost the battlefields on which their livelihood depended, they lived by cheating and swindling wherever they went.
units.source_zh: 如今他们失去了赖以生存的战场，便以四处坑蒙拐骗为生。

units.source_en: Such beasts had to be dealt with by the methods used to tame animals.
units.source_zh: 对付这帮畜生，必须得驯畜之法。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这帮小人在乱世之中亦是恶事做尽。战争时期他们靠去百姓家抢掠，或是把战亡者的盔甲扒下来变卖，才活到现在。如今他们失去了赖以生存的战场，便以四处坑蒙拐骗为生。对付这帮畜生，必须得驯畜之法。

paragraphs.source_en: The only problem was Arima Harunobu. However dearly he cherished the ancestral lands handed down to him, his conduct was far too rash for a daimyō renowned throughout the realm. It was not that he lacked ability. When his licensed trading ship was sunk at sea, had he not taken revenge by attacking a Portuguese vessel that sailed into Nagasaki? People called Arima courageous, but in truth, without determining what cargo the ship carried, he had sent his own goods to the seabed as well.

units.source_en: The only problem was Arima Harunobu.
units.source_zh: 问题只在于有马晴信。

paragraphs.source_zh: 问题只在于有马晴信。不论多么眷恋祖先传下来的旧领，作为天下闻名的大名，他的所为都太过轻率。他也并非少了本事，当朱印船在海上被击沉时，为了报仇，他不是袭击了航至长崎的葡国船吗？世人都说有马英勇，其实他没查明那条船上运了什么货物，便把自己的东西也沉入了海底。

paragraphs.source_en: If Ieyasu learned the truth, he would fly into a rage. Whether or not it was a conspiracy, a powerful daimyō allowing himself to be cheated out of six thousand ryō in silver was conduct no warrior could tolerate.

paragraphs.source_en: But when that time came, Chōan could intercede for Arima: if Ieyasu ordered him to commit seppuku, Chōan could plead for his life; if he was imprisoned, Chōan could first have him brought to Hachiōji and then consider what to do at leisure.

paragraphs.source_en: After sending Arima Harunobu a letter through Sotelo, Chōan immediately contacted Edo and summoned Okamoto Daihachi to Sunpu.

paragraphs.source_en: Okamoto Daihachi was handsome, and his clothes were exceedingly lavish. Everything from his larger and smaller ornaments to his medicine case was conspicuously decorated with gold leaf. Had the man been born among the townspeople, he would probably have dressed as flamboyantly as a kabuki performer. But in his present station he was, after all, a warrior among whom frugality was prized as a virtue, and so he still exercised a measure of restraint.
